basis: Inspected native assembly and exact original status/record comparisons for readable C normal probability and prepared t conversion; CPU scratch RAM, statistics lifecycle, malformed records and physical interrupt timing are outside these claims.

ranges.scope: Absolute-input positive normal tail, zero/large-input special cases, six coefficient loads, ordered Horner/exponential/gaussian normalization
P/Q/R signed-tail selection, original early error preservation, five significant digit rounding and negative-result clamp
Prepared t conversion using x mean/population deviation, ordinary subtraction, division, cleanup and record/status return
